mapper.sql: id, form_no, title, description, fields_json, status, submit_count, creator, create_time, update_time
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO form (form_no, title, description, fields_json, status, submit_count, creator, create_time, update_time) VALUES (#{formNo}, #{title}, #{description}, #{fieldsJson}, #{status}, #{submitCount}, #{creator}, NOW(), NOW())
mapper.select: SELECT FROM form WHERE form_no = #{formNo} LIMIT 1
SELECT FROM form WHERE id = #{id} LIMIT 1
